answer.rationale: Current data shows activation is down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion down 4% QoQ. Memory 91 (activation messaging) directly addresses the engagement gap and is the most time-sensitive lever—it can be deployed rapidly within the product. Memory 86 (simplified onboarding) supports the completion decline but requires UI/flow changes with longer deployment cycles. Activation messaging offers immediate diagnostic value: if it lifts engagement, we confirm the problem is motivational/discovery rather than fundamental product friction, informing future decisions on onboarding redesign or pricing response. This preserves optionality for the competitive pricing threat while addressing the most acute metric deterioration. Enterprise sales assist and referral incentives are misaligned to current crises. Promotional pricing is defensible but risks margin and doesn't solve the activation/onboarding structural issues driving the QoQ decline. Verifying memory 86 and 91 will confirm effect sizes and any cohort or seasonality notes that affect confidence in replication.
